transcript.text: Hello! How can I help you with Massachusetts RMV services today?
What documents do I need to get a REAL ID at the Massachusetts RMV?

To get a REAL ID at the Massachusetts RMV, you'll need to bring original or acceptable printed paper documents: one proving your identity and lawful presence, such as a valid U.S. passport or certified birth certificate; one showing your Social Security number; and two proving Massachusetts residency dated within the last 60 days.
